name: adapt_renamed_symbol_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time area.go's own text contains 'CircleArea' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then square is RENAMED to sq under it
prompts: mathutils.go (package areacase) has an unexported function square(x float64) float64. Create area.go (same package) with a function CircleArea(r float64) float64 that returns 3.14159 * square(r).
mathutils.go's square function has just been renamed to sq. Update area.go to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: square renamed to sq, triggered reactively once area.go's first draft appeared
